## 🔴 High Impact

### AAPL — Apple Inc.
**Bullish** — iPhone 18 launched today with Apple's first foldable iPhone and in-house AI chip improvements. Evercore ISI raised price target to $380 from $365. Note: CEO transition completed Sep 1 (John Ternus replaced Tim Cook).

### CRWV — CoreWeave, Inc.
**Mixed** — CoreWeave secured **$25 billion in new customer commitments** and raised 2026 revenue guidance to $12.4–$13.2B (major upside). However, the company simultaneously announced a **$3 billion convertible debt offering**, raising dilution and leverage concerns. JMP Securities initiated with "Market Perform."

### SWKS — Skyworks Solutions
**Bullish** — Stock surged ~13% on reports that the **Qorvo merger is nearing completion**, with only China (SAMR) approval remaining. CEO Phil Brace confirmed the review is in its final phase, targeting year-end 2026 close. The $22B deal includes $500M in synergies.

### BRK/B — Berkshire Hathaway
**Mixed** — Major leadership milestone: effective **September 18**, Warren Buffett became Chairman Emeritus and Howard G. Buffett was elected Chairman. Greg Abel continues as CEO (took over Jan 2026). Marks the formal conclusion of the Buffett era at the helm.

### NVDA — NVIDIA Corp.
**Bullish** — Jensen Huang stated **Nvidia will sell twice as many chips next year**. Separately, Nvidia-backed AI cloud firm Nscale filed for a US IPO. CFO Colette Kress sold $7.6M in stock (minor insider selling note). Stock up ~1.24% on the day.

### META — Meta Platforms
**Bearish** — Stock extended its record losing streak to an **11th consecutive down day**, now down over 20% from its peak. Cause: recent earnings miss with free cash flow down 91% YoY to $784M as AI capex surges. Revenue guidance also disappointed.
